The men's bath is also equipped with a sauna and a cold bath. Warming up will also boost your metabolism. Relax and soothe the fatigue of the day. 03 A free breakfast that will delight your body Our attached restaurant offers a choice of familiar Japanese food, familiar Western cuisine, and Vietnamese cuisine.
